title: Exact oracle complexity for function-value suboptimality under weighted initial conditions
summary: We determine the exact worst-case function-value suboptimality after $N$ first-order oracle calls on $L$-smooth, $μ$-strongly convex functions under a nonnegative weighted combination of the initial squared distance, function-value suboptimality, and squared gradient norm. Excluding the case where no strict improvement in function-value suboptimality can be guaranteed, the exact deterministic minimax risk in dimension $d\geq2N+1$ is characterized by the unique solution of a single scalar equation involving an $N$-step recurrence.
